flags_catalog.took_shard: The player picked up the God-Heart Shard
flags_catalog.trusted_priest: The player accepted the Salt Priest's offer
flags_catalog.saved_healer: The player protected Mira from the Salt Priests
flags_catalog.found_map: The player discovered the hidden map to the God-Heart

nodes.text:
You stand at the edge.
The salt flats stretch forever.
A cold wind howls.
Your journey begins now.
What will you do?
The path calls you forward.
There is no turning back.
nodes.image_prompt: A lone figure at the edge of endless white salt flats, cold blue horizon, desolate landscape

nodes.text:
The salt crunches underfoot.
Something glints in the distance.
A black crystal pulses faintly.
It calls to you silently.
Do you approach it?
The air grows colder here.
Your breath forms white clouds.
nodes.image_prompt: A black crystal shard glowing red on white salt flats, cold atmosphere, mysterious discovery

choices.consequence_hint: The Shard pulses against your skin

nodes.text:
Thorn's Hearth is quiet today.
Mira sits by the spring.
"You've come far," she says.
Her eyes study your face.
"The Salt Priests seek you."
She offers you fresh water.
"But I can help you."
nodes.image_prompt: An elderly healer by a natural spring in a small settlement, warm light, peaceful refuge

choices.consequence_hint: Trust is a luxury in the Marches

nodes.text:
The Salt Temple looms ahead.
White walls glow from within.
A priest blocks the entrance.
"The High Priest awaits," he says.
His voice is hollow, distant.
Salt crunches beneath his robes.
Choose your path carefully.
nodes.image_prompt: A glowing white salt cathedral, a masked priest blocking the entrance, tense standoff

choices.consequence_hint: The High Priest has been waiting

conditional_text.append: The Shard pulses hot against your chest.

nodes.text:
Malachar stands before the altar.
His mask reflects candlelight.
"You carry something precious."
His voice echoes through the hall.
"The Shard belongs here."
He extends a pale hand.
"Give it to me."
nodes.image_prompt: A masked high priest reaching out beneath glowing salt walls, intense confrontation

choices.choice_text: Refuse and fight your way out
choices.consequence_hint: A Salt Wraith rises to stop you
The priest lets you go — for now

nodes.text:
Behind the temple, salt-storms rage.
An old crypt lies half-buried.
Ancient carvings cover its walls.
A map glows on stone.
It shows the God-Heart's location.
Your hands tremble slightly.
This changes everything.
nodes.image_prompt: Ancient carved crypt behind a salt temple, glowing map on stone wall, mysterious discovery

nodes.text:
A Salt Wraith rises from the floor.
Its scream freezes your blood.
It charges with ghostly speed.
You raise your weapon.
Pure water is its weakness.
You pour your waterskin.
The Wraith dissolves, shrieking.
nodes.image_prompt: A translucent salt wraith screaming in a glowing salt temple, water splashing against it, desperate combat

choices.consequence_hint: The heart of the temple awaits

nodes.text:
The inner sanctum opens wide.
A vast chamber stretches below.
The God-Heart beats in chains.
Malachar stands at the center.
"You cannot stop this."
The Heart's pulse shakes stone.
"Join me or perish."
nodes.image_prompt: A giant black heart suspended by salt chains in a vast underground chamber, dramatic confrontation

choices.consequence_hint: The Shard burns in your hand

nodes.text:
The truth lies bare at last.
The god's heart still beats.
You understand now the cost.
Some secrets cannot be buried.
The salt accepts all debts.
Your journey ends here.
But the Marches remember.
nodes.image_prompt: A vast underground chamber, a giant pulsing black heart of a dead god, a lone figure facing the truth

conditional_text.append: The Shard in your hand sings one final note.

endings.epitaph: The Marches claim another keeper of secrets.

nodes.text:
The God-Heart shatters with light.
The chains snap, one by one.
Malachar screams as salt crumbles.
The temple begins to fall.
You run through collapsing halls.
Fresh air hits your face.
The Marches are free at last.
nodes.image_prompt: A salt temple collapsing behind a lone figure emerging into dawn light, triumphant escape

endings.epitaph: The dead god's grip is broken. The salt may yet bloom.

nodes.text:
You kneel before the Heart.
Malachar places his hand on yours.
Power floods through your veins.
The god's voice fills your mind.
Your sister's memory fades.
You are no longer yourself.
The new vessel rises.
nodes.image_prompt: A dark figure kneeling before a pulsing black heart, being consumed by red light, tragic transformation

endings.epitaph: Eldrin Vane is gone. Only the vessel remains.
